question: May the LongCat provider forward the complete longcat.chat cookie jar to its isolated same-host quota transport because the required SSO cookie name is undocumented?
rationale: Tests can verify transport mechanics but cannot decide whether this credential scope is an acceptable permanent security boundary.

options.title: Accept the isolated full-cookie boundary
options.body: Allow complete same-host cookie forwarding after current-head live proof confirms quota fetching, redirect handling, and expired-session recovery.

options.title: Require a minimal cookie allowlist
options.body: Hold the PR until the required authentication cookies are identified and only those values are forwarded.

options.title: Pause the provider
options.body: Defer LongCat until the service exposes a documented usage API or stable authentication contract.

recommendation.title: Accept the isolated full-cookie boundary
recommendation.body: Allow complete same-host cookie forwarding after current-head live proof confirms quota fetching, redirect handling, and expired-session recovery.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner and provider-architecture author is the best available owner for a new credential boundary.
